# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Follow best practices for code readability and maintainability.
- Use imperative mood for instructions (e.g., "Use X" instead of "You should use X").

## Code Style
- Avoid unnecessary braces in if-else statements to enhance readability.
- Use LOG_DEBUG macros only in DEBUG builds to prevent log file flooding.
- Do not insert blank lines in the body of a function or method. Prefer compact code; if functionality needs to be separated, extract it into its own functions instead of using blank lines or comment lines for separation.
- Do not include declaration areas; if variable declarations need to be separated, extract them into their own functions.
